name: pk-help-custom
description: Premium custom PC build service website (Next.js, Prisma, Telegram)

scripts.db:push: node scripts/with-env.mjs npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/with-env.mjs npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && node scripts/with-env.mjs npx tsx prisma/seed-components.ts && node scripts/with-env.mjs npx tsx prisma/seed-showcase.ts
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/with-env.mjs npx prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts && tsx prisma/seed-components.ts && tsx prisma/seed-showcase.ts && next build
